# SOURCE_MANIFEST.jsonl — Schema (manifest_version 1.1)

**Generated by:** `scripts/source_manifest/build_source_manifest.py`
**Location:** `data/source-manifest/SOURCE_MANIFEST.jsonl` — one JSON object per
line, one line per source file, sorted by `relative_path`. Committed to git;
the raw source files are not.

Supersedes the v1.0.0 single-document `docs/source-manifest/SOURCE_MANIFEST.json`
(2026-06-11) as the canonical machine-readable record. The v1.0.0 file is
retained for its per-file `currency_evidence` quotations.

## Per-line fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `manifest_version` | string | Schema version of this manifest line (`"1.1"`). |
| `generated_at` | string | ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the build run that produced the line. |
| `relative_path` | string | Path from the repository root, forward slashes, including the source-root folder name. |
| `filename` | string | Basename. |
| `extension` | string | Lowercased extension including dot (`".pdf"`, `".csv"`, `".txt"`). |
| `size_bytes` | integer | File size in bytes. |
| `sha256` | string | Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file bytes. Content identity key. |
| `source_root` | string | `"Benchbook.ai Database Files"` — the source folder as observed at build time (permanent home pending the Judge's storage decision). |
| `source_type` | enum | `statute` \| `rule` \| `dcs_policy` \| `metadata` \| `unknown` \| `excluded`. See classification rules. |
| `authority_family` | enum | `tca_title_36` \| `tca_title_37` \| `tenn_rules_juvenile_practice_procedure` \| `tenn_rules_evidence` \| `dcs_policies_procedures` \| `metadata` \| `unknown`. |
| `authority_range_label` | string \| null | For split statute exports, the filename stem encoding the section range (e.g., `"37_1_101_37_1_201"`, `"37-11-103"`). `null` otherwise. |
| `approval_status` | enum | `pending_judge_approval` \| `approved` \| `rejected` \| `not_required_metadata` \| `not_required_excluded`. Initial state: `pending_judge_approval` for every statute/rule/dcs_policy/unknown file; `not_required_metadata` for metadata files. Only Judge Eckel's express written approval moves a file to `approved`. |
| `corpus_designation` | string \| null | `"pending_judge_designation"` on `Tenn. R. Evid..pdf` — it is **not** an answer-corpus source unless and until the Judge designates it (answer corpus, guardrail/reference corpus, or both). `null` elsewhere. |
| `storage_status` | enum | `source_of_record_candidate` for all current entries. Becomes `source_of_record` once the Judge's storage decision is executed. |
| `notes` | string | Free text: DCS chapter folder, classification caveats, designations. |

## Classification rules (conservative — never guess)

| Condition | source_type | authority_family |
|---|---|---|
| `Title 36/*.pdf` | `statute` | `tca_title_36` |
| `Title 37/*.pdf` | `statute` | `tca_title_37` |
| `Tenn. R. Juv. P. Rules.pdf` (root) | `rule` | `tenn_rules_juvenile_practice_procedure` |
| `Tenn. R. Evid..pdf` (root) | `rule` | `tenn_rules_evidence` |
| `DCS P&P/**/*.pdf` | `dcs_policy` | `dcs_policies_procedures` |
| CSV/TXT/MD/README/index files in the DCS tree | `metadata` | `metadata` |
| Anything unclassifiable | `unknown` | `unknown` |
| Outside the approved closed universe (stray titles, case law) | `excluded` | `unknown` |

Classification is by location and extension only. **Legal currentness is never
inferred from filenames**; currency evidence comes from read-only inspection of
the PDFs themselves (see `MANIFEST_REPORT.md` §4, 2026-06-11 audit) and is a
separate question from classification.

## Companion outputs (same directory)

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `SOURCE_MANIFEST_SUMMARY.json` | Build metadata; total files/bytes; counts by source type, authority family, approval status, extension; anomaly counts and details (non-PDF, empty, unusually large >10 MB, unknown, excluded, unexpected top-level entries); hash-verification result. |
| `SOURCE_MANIFEST_DUPLICATES.json` | Groups of files sharing one SHA-256 (cross-listed DCS documents). |
| `SOURCE_MANIFEST_UNKNOWN_FILES.json` | Files classified `unknown`/`excluded` with reasons, plus unexpected top-level entries. |

## Invariants

1. One line per file on disk; one file on disk per line (verified each build).
2. Rerunning the builder with `--verify-against` compares every hash to the
   prior record; any mismatch, addition, or deletion exits with code 2 — a
   stop-and-ask condition. Nothing downstream may run after a failed verify.
3. `approval_status` and `corpus_designation` transitions require the Judge's
   written instruction, recorded with a dated note.
4. Phase C+ ingestion must refuse files absent from the manifest or not
   `approved`.
